description: A sleek, predatory beast with metallic silver claws that glint in the light. The Silverclaw Hunter is known for its agility, stealth, and precision in the hunt. Its eyes are sharp and calculating, always observing its prey from the shadows before striking with deadly accuracy.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The Silverclaw Hunter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The Silverclaw Hunter has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Hunter's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Silverclaw Hunter makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage.
